description: This file defines classes related to MPEG section parsing and management within the WPEFramework project. It includes the 'Section' class for handling individual MPEG sections and the 'Table' class for managing collections of sections, including validation, storage, and manipulation of MPEG table data.

classes.name: Section
classes.description: Represents an MPEG section, providing methods to validate, extract fields, and compute CRC for integrity.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: Manages a collection of MPEG sections, allowing storage, validation, addition, and replacement of sections within an MPEG table.

methods.name: Section()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing an empty section.

methods.name: Section(const Core::DataElement& data)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the section with provided data.

methods.name: Section(const Section& copy)
methods.description: Copy constructor.

methods.name: ~Section()
methods.description: Destructor.

methods.name: operator=(const Section& RHS)
methods.description: Assignment operator.

methods.name: IsValid()
methods.description: Checks if the section data is valid based on size, syntax, and CRC.

methods.name: TableId()
methods.description: Returns the table ID of the section.

methods.name: HasSectionSyntax()
methods.description: Indicates if the section has syntax.

methods.name: Length()
methods.description: Returns the length of the section.

methods.name: Extension()
methods.description: Returns the extension field of the section if syntax is present.

methods.name: Version()
methods.description: Returns the version of the section if syntax is present.

methods.name: IsCurrent()
methods.description: Indicates if the section is current.

methods.name: IsNext()
methods.description: Indicates if the section is the next version.

methods.name: SectionNumber()
methods.description: Returns the section number.

methods.name: LastSectionNumber()
methods.description: Returns the last section number.

methods.name: Hash()
methods.description: Computes a hash value for the section based on its fields.

methods.name: Data()
methods.description: Returns the data element representing the section data.

methods.name: GetNumber<TYPE>(uint16_t offset)
methods.description: Template method to extract a number of specified type from the section data at a given offset.

methods.name: ValidCRC()
methods.description: Validates the CRC of the section data.

methods.name: Table(const Core::ProxyType<Core::DataStore>& data)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the table with data storage.

methods.name: Storage(const Core::ProxyType<Core::DataStore>& data)
methods.description: Replaces current table data with new data storage.

methods.name: IsValid()
methods.description: Checks if the table is valid based on section count and last section number.

methods.name: TableId()
methods.description: Returns the table ID.

methods.name: Extension()
methods.description: Returns the extension of the table.

methods.name: GetNumber<TYPE>(uint16_t offset)
methods.description: Template method to extract a number from the table data.

methods.name: Clear()
methods.description: Clears the table data and resets internal state.

methods.name: Data()
methods.description: Returns the data element of the table.

methods.name: AddSection(const Section& section)
methods.description: Adds a section to the table, replacing existing sections if necessary.

methods.name: Insert(const Core::DataElement& data, uint16_t allocatedLength, uint16_t offset)
methods.description: Inserts or replaces data within the table's data buffer at a specified offset.
